test_title: PYST 1: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1 )
subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

In about two months, / our family will be / leaving to Australia / to settle there
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **leaving to Australia**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Replace **"to" **with **"for"** to make the sentence correct.
 
• We can use **"to"** as a preposition to **indicate a destination or direction**.
 
 
• **Example - ***We thought we should walk **to** the bakery for breakfast because it is such a beautiful day.​*
 
 
 
• **"For"** is a preposition which is used with **a period to say how long something goes on**.
 
 
• **Example -** *The release of her new album is scheduled **for **next August.*
 
 
 
• Here in the given sentence **"in about two months"** is mentioned to show the time period. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

__
 
• For example, **"I am leaving for London"** means that **you are leaving your present place, and your future goal is to arrive in London.**
 
• **"To"** is also a preposition, but it **shows movement toward a place.**

**​**Therefore, it is clear that the correct answer is **option 3.**

**Corrected sentence:*** In about two months, our family will be leaving **for __**Australia to settle there*

75
